title: 潮塔裂光

generationRuns.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. 为塔罗高塔独立升级主题创作一张1024x1536竖幅完整不透明母版。参考图仅作为人物身份、细腻古典奇幻绘画质感与高塔牌义参考，创造独立的新场景与构图。潮塔裂光：海岸灯塔上部局部裂开，一道柔和金色主裂光显露内部支撑。唯一高塔在右中高耸，左下安全岩岸平台上恰好两位旅行者背影远望，海村在远左完整无损。塔基及完整岩岸相连，两人脚下平台不孤立。风暴蓝、石白、少量金色；海浪和云层有纵深。 画面表达揭示与重建，塔保持整体稳定，仅上部局部裂开。两人都站在地面安全距离外，不从塔上坠落，不站在碎片正下方。自然肤色、人物身体与手脚完整；人物和核心物件离外沿至少5%，承重地形延伸至下方出血。细腻手绘油画与精致收藏卡插画，窄金线边框配主题角饰，画面丰富清晰而光效克制。不要文字、数字、标题、水印、签名，不画灾难爆炸，不生成多塔、多主闪电或额外人物。

Edit the supplied image. Output exactly one 1024x1536 image. Keep the original canvas coordinates and size of RETAINED objects only. Objects explicitly removed must be deleted completely; do not preserve their number. No redesign, no recentering, no frame except when frame is specifically requested. BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY. Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 塔与裂口结构同组；缺口碎片可独立，地面两人必须保留安全空间；本主题支撑归属：塔基及完整岩岸一组，两人脚下平台不孤立. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.

productionDetail.specificQA: 一塔一道主裂光、地面两人；人不落塔、不站坠石正下方，远处房屋完整
productionDetail.samplePrinciple: 借鉴五样本的完整承接、真实透明、主题材质和极端倾斜复核，不按槽位强行套题材。
productionDetail.motion: 仅少量前景微光呼吸；主体、核心符号和承重结构不自动相对运动。

resolvedFindings.evidence: 背景保留完整主塔，与主体层主塔重复；不同景深会产生轮廓错位风险。
